hints.title: Two Minimum Threshold Tracking
hints.text: Maintain two thresholds representing the smallest element seen so far and the smallest second element of an increasing pair.

hints.title: Greedy Escalation Cascade
hints.text: If the current number is smaller than first, update first. Else if smaller than second, update second. Otherwise, it is strictly greater than both.

hints.title: Three Element Ascending Detection
hints.text: Initialize first and second to infinity. For each number x, if x is less than or equal to first, set first to x. Else if x is less than or equal to second, set second to x. Else return true.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all index triplets requires cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking two scalar thresholds enables single-pass O(N) detection using strictly O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should explain why updating first to a smaller value does not invalidate an existing valid second threshold.
